result.summary: Found 1 critical content issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section title.

issues.description: The section heading displays a raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the actual translated text (e.g., 'Popular near you'). This indicates a broken or missing string resource.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly mapped to a translated string in all supported languages so the correct human-readable title is shown.
